description: Returns the member's own teams, the ones they are on or have played for, which come from their affiliations. Call it when the person asks about their own teams, as in 'what teams am I on', and set thisYear:true for this year's. A question that names a team, a club or a player is about that one, so use the other tools for it, signed in or not. Needs a signed-in member, because it answers about them. A key with no member gets the error member_required.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

thisYear.description: Set true for 'this year / this season' — the current league year's teams only. Omit for all covered teams.

name: query_my_teams
title: Your own teams
